content: {"praised":["Elizabeth Reaser delivers a striking, pitch‑perfect performance.","The film portrays a tender, slow romance with land.","It depicts Norwegian immigrant life in Minnesota beautifully.","The setting feels like fresh Minnesota plains air.","The story is a familiar, heartfelt love tale."],"criticized":["The pacing is interminably slow and confusing.","The plot is implausible and heavily propaganda‑laden.","The script contains jarring inconsistencies and unclear themes.","Flashbacks are poorly executed and confusing.","The film’s tone is one‑note, solemn throughout."]}
